selected_reviews.scope_reviewed: Table 29 OpenAction action and §12.6.2 action-chain ordering / repeated references.
selected_reviews.evidence: Current interact::open_action reads and performs remaining OpenAction actions; action::read's path-local cycle handling preserves repeated siblings; action tests cover a two-node cycle and nested order. Current viewer mixed_action_order_audit exposes a script after an OCG change.
selected_reviews.verdict: The reviewed Next interpretation is consistent with Table 196 and NOTE 1: order is depth-first and an action repeated in separate array positions is a separate occurrence. The current source supports this. An observable duplicate-reference assertion is still missing from the tracked action test bodies inspected here; see draft. No broader ADR re-review claimed.

selected_reviews.scope_reviewed: Archive-transform treatment when a forbidden action appears within a /Next sequence.
selected_reviews.evidence: ADR says surviving descendants are promoted at a removed node while preserving depth-first sequence. No archive-transform test was re-audited in this bounded shard.
selected_reviews.verdict: No contrary evidence found; defer its transform assertion to the archive-conversion coverage. This is not a whole-ADR certification.

selected_reviews.scope_reviewed: Host policy for URI handoff after URI resolution.
selected_reviews.evidence: Table 210 defines the URI and IsMap behavior; Event::OpenUri is emitted at viewer-core boundary, while host::policy owns open/refuse/ask/warn levels. This is machine policy, not a requirement to launch a browser or any particular handler.
selected_reviews.verdict: Keep policy choice distinct from source conformance. No basis found to require one particular host setting or native browser behavior.

selected_reviews.scope_reviewed: Completing relative URI resolution using the opened document's location.
selected_reviews.evidence: EC3 #256 explicitly broadens the Base and URI-dictionary text to all relative URIs; the ADR and current host policy are consistent with location being a host fact. This does not change IsMap's click geometry.
selected_reviews.verdict: No change recommended for this point; the audit did not review every relative-URI caller.

selected_reviews.scope_reviewed: Launch target boundary between program execution, PDF opening, and non-PDF handoff.
selected_reviews.evidence: Table 207 permits an application or a document to open/print; its /F does not supply a universal program/document classifier. The program-launch departure is explicit; existing integration tests probe PDF opening and host outcomes for non-PDF bytes.
selected_reviews.verdict: The boundary is explicit and the integration coverage is relevant. Describe non-PDF classification/handoff as owner/host policy, not as an ISO mandate. No change recommended on evidence reviewed.
